title: Local Administrators membership addition command
description: Detects net or PowerShell commands requesting a member addition to the built-in local Administrators group using explicit English, German or SID forms. Confirm the actual membership change from account-management telemetry.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may add an account to the local Administrators group to retain elevated access.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents local group membership changes through net localgroup and PowerShell under additional local accounts, while Microsoft warns that Administrators members have full control; approved provisioning can produce the same event.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify explicit net localgroup additions to English or German local Administrators and PowerShell additions with a bounded Administrators group or well-known SID argument. Other locales, aliases and dynamically resolved groups require additional telemetry.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Identify the added member and change initiator, then confirm the privilege grant against an approved access request.
steps: Confirm the command's result in follow-on process, file, registry or service telemetry; a process-start event records intent and does not prove successful execution.
Review the full command line, device, initiating account, parent process and added member.
Confirm the endpoint role, expected local Administrators baseline and an approved joiner, support or deployment change.
Remove unauthorized membership, disable suspicious accounts and investigate subsequent privileged activity.
false_positives: Approved endpoint provisioning, support access and software-management workflows

validation.expected_outcome: Match explicit local Administrators addition commands; reject group-name prefixes, member-name coincidences, /domain net operations, queries and unrelated tools.

limitations: Authorized administration can produce this event. The rule does not independently establish compromise or completion of a command; assess identity, target and change approval.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
